notes: The registered C row requires POS_DEAD and LVL_IMMORT; the focused test pins this command-surface gate (R2/R5e).
The shared POS_DEAD dispatcher rejection is already proven by the purge gate boundary (R5b/R5c).
A caller without PRF_QUEST is rejected before argument parsing with C's exact quest-participation message (R1/R2/R5e).
PLR_NOSHOUT blocks the quest channel with C's shared You cannot quest-say! response (R1/R2/R5e).
An empty argument reaches CMD_NAME capitalization and C's exact Qecho? chide (R1/R3/R5e).
A non-empty qecho reaches the actor and every other questing descriptor, while the non-questing peer receives nothing; the sleeping questing peer arm is included (R1/R3/R5e).
C consumes the post-command remainder and preserves internal and trailing spaces; Go uses the transport raw-argument path (R1/R2/R5e).
delete_ansi_controls removes C color markers before act() capitalizes and emits the raw qecho (R1/R4/R5e).
PRF_NOREPEAT changes only the actor's self copy to Okay.; questing recipients still receive the capitalized message (R1/R3/R5e).
The TO_VICT|TO_SLEEP recipient path delivers qecho to a sleeping quest participant (R1/R3/R5e).
A questing descriptor flagged PLR_WRITING is excluded from the qecho recipient loop, while a normal questing peer remains eligible (R1/R5e).
